Cuba certainly has strong potential for ocean-based renewable energy, including wave and tidal power. The challenge is that these technologies can be expensive to develop and maintain, especially in harsh saltwater conditions, and they require significant investment, infrastructure, and specialized equipment.
Still, with Cuba’s long coastline, it’s an interesting possibility for the future.

The Cuban people will not surrender. They rose up and rejected Batista. They endured and persevered through Castro. And for over six decades—since 1962—they have survived the crushing weight of the U.S. embargo, bending but never breaking.
